note: File header bytes are read from user-controlled input into header_start structure
page_size is set from user-controlled input; used to allocate the page buffer
Page buffer of page_size bytes is allocated; subheader reads must stay within this
subheader_count is read from page data without checking that page_header_size + subheader_count * subheader_pointer_size <= page_size

code: offset = sas_read4(&shp[0], ctx->bswap); len = sas_read4(&shp[4], ctx->bswap)
note: When subheader_count is large, shp advances past the page buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow read on sas_read4(&shp[4])
